extension.summary: 显示自定义播放器进程信息
extension.description: Öffnet ein eigenes Prozessinformationen-Fenster. Dieses enthält Codec-, Video- und Audio-Details zum aktuell abgespielten Medium.
Opens a separate process information window. This window displays codec, video, and audio details for the currently playing media.
打开一个独立的进程信息窗口。此窗口显示当前播放媒体的编解码器、视频和音频详细信息。
extension.news: v1.7.1.1 - Merged upstream v1.7.1 (variant overlays: SDR narrow panel, HDR/HLG/DV wide panel with metadata column; new Dolby Vision detail section). - Dolby Vision playback shows the speaker graphic (318x228) floating top-right above the panel (the DV panel interior is fully occupied by right-aligned metadata values and the L5 icons). - Custom speaker/codec block is now variant-aware: SDR shows the full speaker graphic + codec logo stack beside the grid with the SDR background extended to x1795; HDR/HLG shows a scaled speaker graphic (318x228) below the static-metadata rows inside the wide panel. - Re-applied fonts.py NotoSans filename fix with update-in-place Font.xml entries.
